text_block_list.text:
Today is the first day of the summer
camp, a
period of intensive race training.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Can you hear them? The waves in the
distance...
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Not only is the sound relaxing, but the
breeze
helps to escape the heat.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Those who conquer summer emerge
victorious in
fall.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер

text_block_list.text:
Our path to the Japan Cup has already
begun...
I'll be relying on your guidance.
text_block_list.name: Грасс Вандер
